stem: One difference between the portrait and the book discussed in the selections is that —

options.label: A
options.text: copies of the incomplete portrait were sold, but the book was sold only after it was completed

options.label: B
options.text: few people saw the portrait while Stuart was alive, but many saw the book manuscript while Tolkien was alive

options.label: C
options.text: Stuart did not prepare before he painted his portrait, but Tolkien spent time preparing to write his book

options.label: D
options.text: the portrait was not considered Stuart's best work, but the book was considered Tolkien's masterpiece
